stories.name: Boeing 737 Max certification
stories.blurb: Boeing is working through regulatory certification and production delays for its 737 Max variants while trying to stabilize output.

stories.name: Archer-Boeing Deal
stories.blurb: Archer Aviation is acquiring Boeing subsidiaries Wisk Aero, Insitu, and SkyGrid, a deal that boosts Archer's growth prospects and stock price in the eVTOL/air taxi market.

stories.name: Boeing stock outlook
stories.blurb: Investors are weighing whether to buy, hold, or sell Boeing shares amid earnings and shifting market sentiment.

stories.name: Boeing Orders and Deliveries
stories.blurb: Boeing is navigating aircraft orders, delivery backlogs, and production delays across its 737 MAX, 787, and 777X programs.

stories.name: Boeing F/A-XX Contract Win
stories.blurb: Boeing won a roughly $20 billion U.S. Navy contract to build the next-generation F/A-XX carrier fighter jet, sending its stock higher and opening a long-term defense revenue stream.

stories.name: Defense Stocks Surge
stories.blurb: Rising government defense spending, missile stockpile initiatives, and strong earnings are driving a broad rally in defense and aerospace stocks like Lockheed Martin, RTX, and Rocket Lab.

stories.name: Aerospace stocks outlook
stories.blurb: Investor-focused coverage comparing aerospace and space companies' earnings, valuations, and growth prospects heading into 2026.

past.name: Boeing Regulatory & Orders Update
past.blurb: Boeing navigates FAA regulatory approvals, safety inspections, and emissions exemptions while securing new aircraft orders and deliveries across its commercial jet lineup.

events.name: Boeing Q2 EPS misses, revenue beats
Amazon Prime Air 767 crashes in Miami

9.text: The FAA certified Boeing's 737 MAX 10 on October 20, clearing the largest MAX variant for deliveries after years of delays. Analysts noted the approval was expected, with Boeing's stock flat and attention now on delivery timing.

6.text: Archer Aviation's stock fell about 50% in 2026 despite completing FAA certification Phase 3 and test flights. Analysts project revenue growing to roughly $506 million by 2028, partly from a Boeing subsidiary acquisition adding $200M+ annually; Vertical Aerospace filed a patent counterclaim.

5.text: Boeing shares rose 1.95% to $188.25 on Oct 15 but remain down about 26% from January highs, with RBC cutting its target to $235 and Barclays holding $300. The company reported 161 third-quarter commercial deliveries, faces an imminent earnings report, and its sales chief is retiring amid $27.5 billion in built-up jet costs.

8.text: Cathay Pacific is in talks with Boeing and Airbus about ordering 50 additional large aircraft. GE Aerospace says its inventory of GEnx engines has grown as engine deliveries outpace aircraft deliveries, and it expects to help Boeing reach a 787 production rate of 10.

10.text: BAE Systems won Space Force terminal and APKWS production contracts and unveiled missile-defense systems; Northrop reported a record $110 billion backlog but lost the Air Force's CCA drone competition to General Atomics and Anduril. Boeing is not mentioned in any of these articles.

7.text: Trump’s holdings overlap with companies he has praised or regulated, and the Magnificent Seven are set to grow Q3 earnings 33.2%. Boeing is not mentioned; the defense-stock angle is absent from these reports.

11.text: GE Aerospace beat Q3 estimates with record $2.25 EPS and 18% revenue growth, raised 2026 guidance, but its stock fell on declining cash flow and aftermarket doubts. Other articles cover Hexcel earnings, RTX's Pratt & Whitney, and rate pressures—none mention Boeing.
